_doc: Map 4 Act III side egg 'Dee's cage' (UPDATE 07, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md §9.2; T-115). Dee's yard rule asks for three things: a casing from the wreck, a coil from the bomber, the honey jar from the lab's kitchen (CageItem nodes, flags cage_<item>; all three set dee_cage_done). Reward: her last line changes (CageItem) and she gets a radio in Act IV (MondlichtController plays DEE_M4D_RADIO_01..03 when dee_cage_done is carried: campaign.json carry_flags dee_*). This quest only tracks the rule for the HUD and the Archive.
